pages.text: You have almost completed the first $(item)Simulation$(), good job!$(br2)To enter the next one you need to go back to the $(item)Portal Hub$() and enter the last piece of $(item)Reinforced Steel$() into the$(br)$(item)Portal Structure$().

pages.title: Casting Large Plates
pages.text: To make the $(item)Steel Large Plate$() you're gonna have to make a $(item)Large Plate Cast$() first.$(br2)A $(item)Large Plate Cast$() can be made by pouring gold or aluminum brass on top of a $(item)Stone Large Plate$().$(br2)$(item)Stone Large Plates$() can be made in the $(item)Part Builder$().

pages.title: Portal Activator
pages.text: The item that activates the $(item)Portal$() to the second $(item)Simulation$() is the $(item)Engineering Hammer$() you made earlier in this $(item)Simulation$().
